toolOfTheDay.name: Supabase Vector
toolOfTheDay.summary: Supabase's open-source vector database toolkit built on PostgreSQL and pgvector, enabling developers to store, index (HNSW / IVFFlat), and query high-dimensional embeddings directly within Postgres. Its cloud and infrastructure runtime provides postgreSQL database engine extended with pgvector C extension, pg_ivm, Row Level Security (RLS), and unified TypeScript/Python SDK clients. Core platform telemetry and performance features include: Supports sub-10ms similarity searches on millions of vectors using HNSW indexing; fully integrates with relational tables, foreign keys, and ACID transactions. Accessible under a Apache-2.0 tier, it empowers teams to build, serve, and monitor AI workloads at scale.
toolOfTheDay.architecture: PostgreSQL database engine extended with pgvector C extension, pg_ivm, Row Level Security (RLS), and unified TypeScript/Python SDK clients.
toolOfTheDay.benchmarks: Supports sub-10ms similarity searches on millions of vectors using HNSW indexing; fully integrates with relational tables, foreign keys, and ACID transactions.
toolOfTheDay.limitations: Vector index build times scale with Postgres RAM allocation; memory tuning required for multi-million vector datasets with high dimensionality.
